cards.text: Jesus and His disciples are almost to Jerusalem, at Bethphage on the Mount of Olives. Jesus sends out two disciples on an errand. Nobody sends ME on errands, friend, because I hop everywhere on a gold base and a quick errand would take all WEEK.

cards.question: Jesus sends the two disciples into the village ahead. He says that at once they'll find a ___ tied there, with her colt beside her.

cards.text: Jesus tells them to untie both animals and bring them to Him. I bet those two feel a LITTLE funny about untying somebody else's donkey.

cards.question: Jesus tells the two disciples what to do if anyone questions them. True or false: Jesus says that whoever questions them will send the animals right away.

cards.text: Here the writer says all of this took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet. He quotes Zechariah 9:9, with an opening line from Isaiah 62:11.

cards.question: The prophet's message is for the Daughter of Zion. Who does he say is coming to her?
The prophet says Zion's King comes riding on a donkey, on a colt. What does he say the King is like?

cards.text: So the two disciples go and do just what Jesus told them. They bring back the donkey and the colt and lay their cloaks on them.

cards.question: The donkey and the colt are covered with the disciples' cloaks now. True or false: Jesus walks beside them instead of sitting on them.

cards.text: Then there's the crowd, and it is MASSIVE. I'm talking circle-the-block-four-times-and-still-no-parking massive.

cards.question: People are all around Jesus as He rides along. What gets spread on the road?

cards.text: Friend, that's a red carpet made out of everybody's jackets. Crowds are going ahead of Jesus and following behind Him, and they're shouting.

cards.question: The crowds ahead of Jesus and behind Him are shouting Hosanna. Who do they shout Hosanna to?

cards.text: And they keep it coming: “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
Jesus enters Jerusalem, and the whole city is stirred. Picture an entire city looking up from its phone at the SAME time.

cards.question: The whole city of Jerusalem is stirred as Jesus enters. True or false: the city already knows exactly who He is.
The city of Jerusalem asks who Jesus is, and the crowds answer. What do the crowds call Him?

answers.text: The prophet from Nazareth in Galilee
The teacher from Bethany in Judea
The rabbi from Capernaum by the sea
